tagline: MALVIN-XD, a Multi Device Whatsapp Bot built by Malvin Tech to Enhance Whatsapp Communication Experience

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Owner's WhatsApp number (with country code, no + or spaces)

TIME_ZONE.description: Timezone used for time-based features (e.g. Africa/Harare)

DATABASE_URL.description: Postgres connection string (free from neon.tech, supabase, render, or Heroku). Falls back to local SQLite (./king/database/database.db) if not set

MALVIN_API_KEY.description: API key from https://api.malvin.gleeze.com (sign up, key is on your dashboard)

PORT.description: Port the bot's web server listens on
